note.title: Identity and relationships with others
note.specFocus: family, friendship, personality and healthy relationships
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
1.1 Identity and relationships with others
Key focus
- family, friendship, personality and healthy relationships.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Nouns and adjectives agree in gender and number; use present, past and future time markers consistently.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Ho quindici anni e vivo con i miei genitori e mia sorella minore.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

I am fifteen and live with my parents and my younger sister.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Vado d’accordo con mia madre perché mi ascolta sempre.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

I get on with my mum because she always listens to me.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Il mio migliore amico è affidabile, ma qualche volta è troppo testardo.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

My best friend is reliable, but sometimes he is too stubborn.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: La settimana scorsa ho litigato con mio fratello per il computer.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

Last week I argued with my brother about the computer.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Dopo dieci minuti abbiamo fatto pace e ci siamo scusati.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

After ten minutes we made peace and apologised to each other.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Per me la lealtà è la qualità più importante in un amico.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

For me, loyalty is the most important quality in a friend.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
Ho quindici anni e vivo con i miei genitori e mia sorella minore. Vado d’accordo con mia madre perché mi ascolta sempre. Il mio migliore amico è affidabile, ma qualche volta è troppo testardo. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: I am fifteen and live with my parents and my younger sister. I get on with my mum because she always listens to me. My best friend is reliable, but sometimes he is too stubborn. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
